categories.name: utils
categories.evidence: Modifies shared cryptographic primitive implementations in src/crypto/sha512.cpp and src/crypto/sha512.h.
categories.rationale: Cleanses cryptographic hash state on destruction so secret key material does not linger in memory. CSHA512 handles RNG seed material and cryptographic keys without wiping internal buffers upon destruction, making this a worthwhile defensive hygiene fix for shared primitives.

categories.name: wallet
categories.evidence: Carries the Wallet maintainer label and directly protects wallet encryption passphrase keys derived in CCrypter.
categories.rationale: Prevents lingering wallet encryption key and IV material from remaining in un-cleansed memory after key derivation. While it improves memory hygiene for CCrypter::BytesToKeySHA512AES and BIP32 seeds, it addresses defense-in-depth rather than an active exploit or fund-loss bug.
